Both also blur the table's two column blocks: the left block (Charges 4/6/8/10) is at 2e-11 suppression, the right block (Charges 6/8/10) additionally includes a 1 mas stellar size; A stamps "1 mas stellar size" on left-block values and B omits it for right-block values. A's quote for the DM claim paraphrases the text layer ("passed through" vs. "passed to"). Note the figure supports the path DM1 (in pupil) → DM2 → focal plane mask → Lyot stop (in pupil); B's three fragment claims are subsets of that single sequence.
